about_short_description.short_description: Yotta Savings offers sweepstakes based games

product.name: Yotta Sweepstakes Games
product.description: A mobile and web-based sweepstakes platform offering games such as YottaBall, where users use entries to compete for YottaCash redeemable for cash prizes, subject to eligibility and verification.

product.name: Prize-Linked Savings
product.description: A savings account that links deposited funds to sweepstakes entries, allowing customers to save money while receiving opportunities to win cash prizes.

product.name: Yotta Debit Card
product.description: A debit card connected to a Yotta account for making purchases and accessing funds through participating payment networks and ATMs.

product.name: Yotta Credit Card
product.description: A consumer credit card that supports purchases, credit-building, and access to Yotta-related rewards or sweepstakes entries.

product.name: Paycheck Perks
product.description: A paycheck and direct-deposit feature that provides account-related benefits, including potential early access to deposited funds and Yotta rewards opportunities.

product.name: Yotta Buckets
product.description: A budgeting and savings organization feature that lets users separate money within their Yotta account for different goals or spending purposes.
